scope: Publish loading via read-only getter over existing opens/restoringSessions and existing ticket generations; emit on real operation start/end. Workbench reuses shared Loading only while no ready active content or evicted content, keeps known tabs/breadcrumbs and error views. No new persisted metadata, transport calls, artificial delays, files tree changes or activation flow changes.
unresolvedBoundary: Before a view activation has started any real restore/open operation, pendingSessions is retained intent, not active I/O; getter deliberately does not invent loading from restored=false. Initial App welcome while activation itself is pending remains its distinct busyProject/boot responsibility, documented in analysis.
testing: Not run and no test file modified. Deferred tests/selected existing regressions specified in ANALYSIS.md.
previewLoadingBoundary: Only while documentLoading, with-preview two-column mode and Preview subtree wait for actual bytes; prevents the full-width loading skeleton sharing a column with stale empty preview. Stored preview preference and ready preview behavior unchanged.
